acceptance: A Hudi maintenance write/read runs end to end with value parity on a recorded Spark/Hudi pair, or unsupported pairs refuse with a clear message.
The Spark Arrow execute path on pyspark 3.5 shows digest parity with collect().
description:
Live verification of #3950 on 2026-11-06 (PySpark 4.2.0, JDK 17) passed the Hudi conversion code, but a real Hudi write or read failed with `HoodieException: Unable to load class` using hudi-spark4.0-bundle 1.1.0. Hudi maintenance paths (perf-dataframe-maintenance-arrow-20261031) therefore have mocked tests only. The pyspark 3.5 execute path of the Spark Arrow collect (#4012) was also not run; only its toPandas conversion was checked on 3.5.7.

Change. Find a Hudi bundle and Spark version pair that works, check what the repo pins, and run the Hudi maintenance write/read end to end with value parity. Run the Spark adapter's execute path on pyspark 3.5 against collect(). If no supported pair exists for Spark 4.x, record the supported matrix in docs and make the Hudi path refuse unsupported versions with a clear message.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
